title: 'fix(candlestick): fix candlestick render error with `series.encode`'
category: bugfix
requirement: '## Context

  Candlestick charts can render incorrectly or fail outright when data is mapped through `series.encode`, particularly in layouts that are not the simplest default case.

  ## Desired outcome

  Candlestick rendering should honor `series.encode` correctly across supported layouts so encoded dimensions still produce a valid candlestick chart.

  ## Acceptance signals

  A candlestick series driven by `series.encode` renders with the expected orientation and geometry instead of crashing or misplacing the candle bodies and whiskers.

  '

content.text: I found the exact upstream fix (apache/echarts PR #21325, merge `3844954`, title `fix(candlestick): fix candlestick render error with series.encode`) and verified the workspace is at the pre-fix state. Reporting the plan.

input.risks:
Existing tests: there are NO jest specs under test/ut/spec touching candlestick, boxplot, or whiskerBoxCommon (verified: `test/ut/spec` contains only api/component/data/model/scale/series/util; `rg -il "candlestick|boxplot|whiskerBox" test/ut/` returns nothing). Verification is therefore visual (test/candlestick.html, test/candlestick-large*.html, test/candlestick-doji.html, test/candlestick-empty.html, test/brush2.html, test/encode.html, test/dataset-charts.html, test/clip.html, test/stream-filter2.html) or via any new spec you add.

Behavior changes to watch, in dependency order:

1. `option.layout` is no longer written back into the series option. Every consumer of `seriesModel.get('layout')` for boxplot/candlestick MUST switch to `getWhiskerBoxesLayout()` in the same commit. I grepped all of src/: the only two are `src/chart/boxplot/BoxplotView.ts:49` and `src/chart/boxplot/boxplotLayout.ts:147` (both listed above). `src/chart/candlestick/*` never read it. Anything external (users reading `chart.getOption().series[i].layout`) will now see `undefined` instead of the derived value — that is the intended "idempotency" fix upstream, but it is an observable API change.

2. New default: when neither axis is `'category'` and `layout` is unspecified, the layout is now `yAxisType === 'time' ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'` instead of always `'horizontal'`. A chart with a time yAxis and a value xAxis that previously rendered (wrongly) as vertical candles will now render horizontally. This is the intended fix but is the main regression surface for existing snapshots.

3. `getWhiskerBoxesLayout()` returns `this._layout`, which is only assigned inside `getInitialData`. Any code path that calls it before `getInitialData` runs would get `undefined` (falls back to the non-'horizontal' branch = vertical). In practice `getInitialData` always runs first for these series; just don't call the accessor from `init`/`mergeOption` prologue.

4. TypeScript: `candlestickLayout.ts` and `CandlestickView.ts` will not compile against `CandlestickSeriesModel` unless the declaration-merged `interface CandlestickSeriesModel extends WhiskerBoxCommonMixin<CandlestickSeriesOption> { getBaseAxis(): Axis2D }` is added (item 3). Do that edit before/with the others. If marking `_baseAxisDim`/`_layout` `private` triggers an "interface incorrectly extends" error under this repo's TS version, drop the `private` modifiers — upstream compiles with them, and `BoxplotSeries.ts` already does the same interface-extends-class merge.

5. Large mode (`large: true`) is NOT orientation-aware even after this fix: `candlestickLayout.largeProgress` packs `[sign, x, yhigh, ylow]` and `LargeBoxPath.buildPath` in `CandlestickView.ts:347-361` does `moveTo(x, y1); lineTo(x, y2)` — i.e. always vertical strokes. Upstream left this untouched. Horizontal candlesticks with >`largeThreshold` (600) points will still draw incorrectly. Flag it, don't silently "fix" it beyond scope.

6. Do NOT add the `if (!itemLayout) { return/continue; }` guards in `CandlestickView.ts` / `candlestickVisual.ts` that appear in the first commit of the upstream PR — they were reverted before merge (the merged `candlestickVisual.ts` is byte-identical to the current workspace file). Adding them would mask the real bug and diverge from upstream.

7. `test/candlestick-horizontal.html` also exercises boxplot with two time axes; if boxplot regressions show up there, they trace to change (2), not to the candlestick layout indices.
